name: review-completed
description: Records that a code review finished at a given stage of the development workflow, along with what was reviewed, who or what reviewed it, what was found, and what happens next.
record_when: Record this entry at the moment a review reaches a terminal state for its stage — the reviewer has finished examining the artifact and reached a verdict — and before the workflow advances to the next stage. This includes reviews that end without any findings, reviews that are abandoned or skipped (record those with an explicit not-applicable outcome rather than omitting the entry), and re-reviews of an artifact that was revised after an earlier review. Do not record it when a review is still in progress, when a review is requested but not yet started, or for informal reading that reaches no verdict. If a stage runs several distinct reviews, record one entry per review.

properties.name: review_stage
properties.description: The workflow stage this review concluded at; use incident_followup for reviews triggered by a production incident.

properties.name: target_ref
properties.description: Pointer to the artifact that was reviewed (a diff, commit, pull request, design document, or plan); use an explicit not-applicable marker when the review covered something with no addressable identifier.

properties.name: reviewer
properties.description: Identity of the reviewer that produced the verdict (person, agent, or tool name); when the review was a panel, name the panel or the lead reviewer.

properties.name: reviewer_kind
properties.description: Whether the verdict came from a human, an LLM, a combination of both, or a deterministic automated tool such as a linter or static analyzer.

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: The verdict reached: whether the artifact may proceed, must be revised, or was never actually judged.

properties.name: max_severity
properties.description: The most severe issue found in this review; use none or an explicit not-applicable marker when nothing was found so a clean review is distinguishable from an unrecorded one.

properties.name: findings_count
properties.description: Total number of distinct findings raised, including trivial and non-blocking ones; record 0 when the review was clean.

properties.name: blocking_findings_count
properties.description: Number of findings that must be resolved before the artifact may proceed; record 0 when nothing blocks.

properties.name: coverage
properties.description: How much of the target the review actually examined, so a shallow pass is not mistaken for a thorough one.

properties.name: findings_summary
properties.description: Prose summary of what was found and the reasoning behind the verdict, including why a clean or not-applicable review produced no findings.

properties.name: completed_at
properties.description: When the review reached its terminal state.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Elapsed time from the review starting to reaching its verdict; use an explicit not-applicable marker when start and end times were not observed.

properties.name: next_action
properties.description: What the workflow should do now that the review is complete.

properties.name: follow_up_ref
properties.description: Pointer to the issue or task created to track deferred findings; use an explicit not-applicable marker when no follow-up work was filed, so 'nothing deferred' is a recorded decision rather than an omission.

properties.name: confidence
properties.description: The reviewer's own confidence that the verdict is correct given the evidence available; optional, but valuable when the reviewer is an LLM.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: Free-form remarks not captured elsewhere, such as context about the review environment, interruptions, or tooling failures.
